title: SpaceX Stock Drops on Ballooning AI Bill
summary: SpaceX shares dropped 14%.  Elon Musk’s  space company late Tuesday said its capital expenditures topped $18 billion last quarter, double the previous quarter’s total, mainly tied to its artificial-intelligence build-out.  AMD shares also fell 7% after Musk said  SpaceX  would exclusively use chips from rival Nvidia, shares of which gained 4%.
